title: Recruit/engage >=2 qualified reviewers (>=1 medical-capable) or a translation NGO
context: The pipeline cannot ship reviewed packs without a reviewer bench, so this task recruits at least two qualified reviewers (at least one medical-capable) or engages a translation NGO. Outreach targets and engagement records are documented. It depends on the qualification criteria.
objective: Recruit/engage at least two qualified reviewers (>=1 medical-capable) or a translation NGO, with the engagement recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: At least two qualified reviewers engaged (at least one medical-capable) or a translation NGO partner engaged, with COI declarations recorded
Each reviewer mapped to language pair(s) and qualification tier per the qualification criteria
Engagement and availability recorded; requestor remains TO BE SECURED until a partner confirms
Gaps in coverage (languages/tiers without a qualified reviewer) explicitly listed
